description: This file implements a recovery key store for managing secret storage keys, including loading, saving, staging, and bootstrapping secret storage with recovery keys in a Matrix client context.

classes.name: MatrixRecoveryKeyStore
classes.description: A class for managing recovery keys and secret storage bootstrap process in a Matrix client.

methods.name: isRepairableSecretStorageAccessError
methods.description: Determines if an error related to secret storage access is repairable.

methods.name: buildCryptoCallbacks
methods.description: Builds cryptographic callback functions for secret storage key retrieval and caching.

methods.name: getRecoveryKeySummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of the stored recovery key, if available.

methods.name: resolveEncodedRecoveryKeyInput
methods.description: Resolves and validates an encoded recovery key input.

methods.name: storeEncodedRecoveryKey
methods.description: Stores an encoded recovery key and updates internal cache.

methods.name: stageEncodedRecoveryKey
methods.description: Stages a recovery key for later commitment.

methods.name: commitStagedRecoveryKey
methods.description: Commits a staged recovery key to persistent storage.

methods.name: bootstrapSecretStorageWithRecoveryKey
methods.description: Bootstraps secret storage using a recovery key, handling key creation and server bootstrap.

methods.name: rememberSecretStorageKey
methods.description: Remembers and caches a secret storage key.

methods.name: loadStoredRecoveryKey
methods.description: Loads a recovery key from disk if available.

methods.name: saveRecoveryKeyToDisk
methods.description: Saves a recovery key to disk.
